votes.latest_response: Strong AI-driven demand and CPO commercialization support the growth thesis, but inventory growth of 178.7% versus revenue growth of 31.5% creates a material execution and capital-efficiency concern. A roughly 52x TTM P/E also leaves limited valuation protection if anticipated growth disappoints.
Strategic inventory build (+178.7% YTD to RMB 1.274B) and improved core-material availability drove Q3 sequential revenue +28.4%, aligning with hyperscaler 800G/1.6T and early CPO volume needs.

The 52x TTM valuation leaves little room and the 35x de-rating math checks out at about -33%, but the strategic inventory view is not yet backed by cash: Q3 operating cash flow covered only 0.52x net profit while inventory rose 178.7% YTD.
